title: Attention Output Shape
prompt:

    softmax(Q·Kᵀ / √d)·V

What is the output shape? Enter `rows cols`.
hint: scores are [n×m]; multiplying by V [m×d] gives [n×d]
recap: Scaled dot-product attention: scores Q·Kᵀ/√d are [n×m]; softmax over the m keys; times V [m×d] gives output [n×d] — the queries' shape.
